name: Statistics Course: Sigmora
subtitle: Statistics Practice and Labs
shortDescription: Adaptive statistics course with five live 3D simulations, practice tests of the length and level you choose, and worked solutions. Free to use.
longDescription:
Statistics Course: Sigmora is an adaptive college statistics course for your phone or tablet. It teaches descriptive statistics, study design, probability, sampling distributions and the central limit theorem, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests and p-values, power, comparing groups, chi-square tests, regression, ANOVA, nonparametric tests, the bootstrap and a first look at Bayesian inference.

### Two Ways to Study
Syllabus view follows the classical course order, unit by unit. Real-World view starts from eight real questions (Can we trust this poll? Is the new teaching method better? A drug trial: effect or chance?) and gives each one the topics you need, in order, plus a build task in a simulation or lab. Switch at any time.

### How It Adapts
Every statistics topic has a mastery estimate. After each answer the app updates it, names the misconception behind a wrong choice (dividing by n instead of n - 1, reading a confidence interval as a probability, mixing up standard deviation and standard error) and picks your next question from your mistakes. Spaced review brings older topics back on a schedule. Follow the personalised path or the traditional order.

### Practise, Check, Understand
- A bank of 2,120 original statistics questions, each with a full worked solution, covering 89 syllabus points. A Coverage screen lists every topic with its exact question counts.
- A placement quiz, unit checkpoints, a mistake notebook and mock exams of 10, 20 or 40 questions, timed or untimed.
- Tap any concept to see it explained at middle school, high school, college and graduate level.
- Cited textbooks, university courses and videos for further study, each opened in a source window with its licence and link.
- Text zoom from 50% to 300% on every screen.

### Five 3d Simulations, Drawn Live on Your Device
Each starts from a real question and runs on the graphics chip, with simulated data. Poll Storm drops 4,096 simulated polls into a heap that grows into the sampling distribution. Sensor Plane fits a plane through 24 sensor readings and shows leverage. Error-Rate Surface shows power and false alarms as one surface. Resample Storm redraws a skewed data set 5,000 times to build a bootstrap interval. Confounder Cube holds temperature fixed so a beach-town myth collapses. Every simulation prints a second-method check next to the answer, shows live formulas over the scene and cites its sources in a window that works offline. Six classic 2D labs are included as well.
monetization: Free core course, optional monthly Plus
